notes.summary: Handwritten manuscript page 67. The page defines saturated parts/supports, names their set Sigma, introduces its two realizations and begins the paragraph on order operations. All cancelled drafts, the raised e and M0, separate underlines, the M0 leader and two low points under réalisations are included. The page ends inside an open parenthesis.
notes.math_reading_decisions: No mathematical assertion was proved or repaired. The paired realizations and the display prompted attention to the unexpected phrase F0 de M; the two visible peaks of M decide its transcription. Local shape comparison distinguishes round zero from looped sigma, one-p cosup from the double-descender full cosupport, and the two P occurrences. The anti compound is kept uncertain because the ink does not settle the old and live layers.
notes.author_checks: The author cancels the opening attempt, s’appelle du/de, de before F0, two drafting attempts, a P/F-like capital, pour, and an earlier layer inside the anti compound. The raised letter in bijection and M0 are additions. No explicit completed proof or independent author validation is identifiable on this page.
notes.title_dates_pagination: Visible manuscript number 67, scan marker retained as 68. No title, date, page count, archive sheet number, separate marginal sentence or typescript is present. H’s editorial instruction to replace the last M by F is not adopted.
